text:
maya_procure: Got update from vendor - APAC A800s hit production snag. Offer: split shipment or wait. Options they propose: 15 new units via 5d air (expedite), 35 loaners next flight (2d, refurbished), or full sea (18d). They also offered 10% discount if we accept loaners + convert later. Need decision - impacts APAC Dedicated backfills.

kevin_ops: Current APAC dedicated pool avg util 89% during peak. Losing 35 would push some tenant queues into throttle band. Can we temporarily shift low-priority jobs to eu-west or us-central? That causes some cross-region egress + latency.

leo_sre: We can add a routing policy: if available_capacity_apac < 87% then route non-sensitive batch workloads to eu-west for up to 72h. Need ops approval. Also concerned about loaner firmware mismatch causing warm start failures; require firmware parity check + burn-in.

nina_logistics: Customs flag: temporary import classification varies. For some APAC countries we need ATA carnet or temporary import permit - delays if manifest incomplete. Vendor must provide serial ranges + HS codes. We can pre-file if we get the manifest now.

tara_vendor: Confirmed loaners are tested R1 and include photos and serials. Deposit requested: 3% refundable per loaner. We can provide pickup labels for RMA returns. If you convert loaners to sale, deposit applies to the purchase price. We'll draft addendum.

finance_bot: Quick calc: if unit_price = $48,000, deposit@3% = $1,440/unit. For 35 loaners that's $50,400 hold. If we take 15 new air @ premium +$2,800/unit => 15 * 2800 = $42k premium. Discount if convert = 10% discount on base price for converted units.

maya_procure: Two procurement asks: 1) escrow vs Redwood hold 2) written RMA SLA for loaners (vendor pickup within 96h for failing unit). Can't commit to balance-sheet exposure without escrow.

kevin_ops: Operational acceptance criteria for loaners: burn-in at depot 36h, smoke test sets pass, kernel-level thermal telemetry within 10% of baseline, and model regression checks (sample eval) pass. If any fail -> vendor RMA pickup within 96h or vendor replacement at no cost.

leo_sre: Add automated parity check script to run on arrival - I'll post the script snippet. We should also add a transient route rule in routing-config: 

```
if apac_capacity_pct < 87 then route(batch) -> eu-west for 72h
```

That prevents user-facing latency spikes.

nina_logistics: Proposed shipping split we can operationalize: 10 new air (5d), 25 loaners (2d), 15 sea (18d). That lowers immediate deposit exposure and gives us a short runway. Need serials to pre-file TE docs and generate temporary import paperwork.

tara_vendor: Can do that split. Sample manifest below: 

AWB: AWB-77-888222
LOANER_SERIALS: A800L-1001..A800L-1025
NEW_SERIALS: A800N-2101..A800N-2110
SEA_BATCH: A800-S-3001..A800-S-3015
HS_CODE: 8471.80.1000

Terms: loaners 30-day loan warranty, refundable deposit 3% per unit, vendor provides photos + serial manifest within 4h. RMA pickup labels included.

maya_procure: Legal needs the deposit/convert language in the addendum. @finance_bot if escrow partner ok we can proceed. Deadline for vendor sign-off EOD.

finance_bot: Escrow ok via our payments partner, recommended to use vendor escrow flow. Accounting treatment: deposit recorded as restricted cash / liability until refunded or applied. I'll follow up with AP.

kevin_ops: Agree to split 10 air / 25 loaners / 15 sea conditional on: vendor-signed addendum, escrow confirmed, and leo_sre parity checks integrated into depot job. We'll gate canary rollouts until burn-in complete.

tara_vendor: Understood - will send addendum and upload manifest now. We'll pre-provide RMA labels and photos.

docsbot: Ticket created: OPS-2109. Attached checklist: manifest, addendum signed, escrow setup, burn-in schedule.

leo_sre: I'll push parity script and add the routing-config patch to the canary playbook.

maya_procure: Decision: approve conditional split (10 air new / 25 loaners / 15 sea). Conditional items must be satisfied before we release Dedicated backfill circuits. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:

(reacts: :thumbsup: from kevin_ops, :eyes: from tara_vendor)
